source.text: רוּחִ֣י חֻ֭בָּלָה יָמַ֥י נִזְעָ֗כוּ קְבָרִ֥ים לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: My spirit is broken, my days are extinguished, graves [are] for me.

en.L: My spirit is broken, my days are extinguished; \q the graves [are] for me.
en.B: My spirit is broken, my days are snuffed out; \q the grave is waiting for me.
en.R: My spirit is crushed, and my life is burning out. \q The grave is ready for me.

es.L: Mi espíritu está quebrantado, mis días se extinguen; \q los sepulcros [son] para mí.
es.B: Mi espíritu está quebrantado, mis días se apagan; \q la tumba me está esperando.
es.R: Mi ánimo está destrozado, y mi vida se va apagando. \q La tumba está lista para mí.

fr.L: Mon esprit est brisé, mes jours sont éteints ; \q les tombeaux [sont] pour moi.
fr.B: Mon esprit est brisé, mes jours s’éteignent ; \q la tombe m’attend.
fr.R: Mon esprit est écrasé, et ma vie s’éteint peu à peu. \q La tombe est prête pour moi.

sw.L: Roho yangu imevunjika, siku zangu zimezimika; \q makaburi [ni] kwa ajili yangu.
sw.B: Roho yangu imevunjika, siku zangu zimezimwa; \q kaburi linanisubiri.
sw.R: Roho yangu imepondeka, na maisha yangu yanazimika. \q Kaburi liko tayari kwa ajili yangu.

vi.L: Tâm thần tôi đã tan vỡ, những ngày của tôi đã tắt; \q các nấm mồ [dành] cho tôi.
vi.B: Tâm thần tôi suy sụp, những ngày đời tôi đã lụi tắt; \q nấm mồ đang chờ tôi.
vi.R: Tinh thần tôi tan nát, đời tôi đang lụi tàn. \q Nấm mồ đã sẵn sàng cho tôi.

ko.L: 내 영이 꺾였고 내 날들이 꺼졌으니, \q 무덤들이 나를 위하여 [있다].
ko.B: 내 영은 꺾이고 내 날들은 꺼져 가니, \q 무덤이 나를 기다린다.
ko.R: 내 마음은 무너졌고 내 목숨은 꺼져 간다. \q 무덤이 나를 맞을 준비를 하고 있다.

pt.L: O meu espírito está quebrantado, os meus dias se apagaram; \q as sepulturas [são] para mim.
pt.B: O meu espírito está quebrantado, os meus dias se apagam; \q a sepultura está à minha espera.
pt.R: O meu espírito está esmagado, e a minha vida está se apagando. \q A sepultura está pronta para mim.

am.L: መንፈሴ ተሰበረ፤ ዘመኔ ጠፋ፤ \q መቃብሮች ለእኔ [ናቸው]።
am.B: መንፈሴ ተሰብሯል፤ ዕድሜዬ ተዳፍኗል፤ \q መቃብር ይጠብቀኛል።
am.R: መንፈሴ ደቅቋል፤ ሕይወቴም እየጠፋች ነው። \q መቃብሩ ተዘጋጅቶልኛል።

hi.L: मेरी आत्मा टूट गई है, मेरे दिन बुझ गए हैं; \q क़ब्रें मेरे लिए [हैं]।
hi.B: मेरी आत्मा टूट चुकी है, मेरे दिन बुझ चले हैं; \q क़ब्र मेरी बाट जोह रही है।
hi.R: मेरा मन कुचला गया है, और मेरा जीवन बुझता जा रहा है। \q क़ब्र मेरे लिए तैयार है।

ru.L: Мой дух сломлен, мои дни угасли; \q гробы — для меня.
ru.B: Мой дух сломлен, мои дни догорают; \q меня ждёт могила.
ru.R: Мой дух раздавлен, моя жизнь догорает. \q Могила уже готова для меня.

ja.L: わたしの霊は砕かれ、わたしの日々は消え去った。 \q 墓がわたしのためにある。
ja.B: わたしの霊は打ち砕かれ、わたしの日々は消えかかっている。 \q 墓がわたしを待っている。
ja.R: わたしの心は打ちのめされ、命の火は消えかけている。 \q 墓が、わたしを迎える用意をしている。

decisions.choice: my spirit is broken: my inner strength is ruined
decisions.reason: Job is still answering Eliphaz (the speech began at 16:1). The noun (ruach) can be "spirit" or "breath", and the verb means to be ruined or broken. Either way Job says his life force is spent; "spirit" fits the next words about his days ending.

decisions.choice: my days are extinguished: my life is going out like a lamp
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a flame being put out. Bildad soon uses the same picture: the lamp of the wicked goes out (18:5-6).

decisions.choice: graves: the grave, the burial place
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is plural, "graves". The plural may mean a burial ground or simply stand for the grave. The sense is that death is all that is left for Job.

decisions.choice: is waiting for me (B), is ready for me (R)
decisions.reason: Hebrew has no verb here: "graves for me". Balanced and Readable supply a verb that says what the short line means.

decisions.choice: the plain written style (해라체) with 나 for Job's lament
decisions.reason: Here Job speaks of himself and to no one in particular, so Korean uses the plain style of a poem; where he turns to his friends it is 하오체 with 그대들 (verse 10), and where he turns to God, 합쇼체 with 주님 and 저 (verses 3-4).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Amharic; where the English of this chapter has a span, the Amharic has the plain pronoun or verb form.

decisions.choice: "बुझ गए हैं" (L), "बुझ चले हैं" (B), "बुझता जा रहा है" (R)
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the picture of a lamp going out (m2), which Hindi uses of life as well.

source.text: אִם־לֹ֣א הֲ֭תֻלִים עִמָּדִ֑י וּ֝בְהַמְּרוֹתָ֗ם תָּלַ֥ן עֵינִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely mockeries [are] with me, and on their provoking dwells my eye.

en.L: Surely mockers [are] with me, \q and my eye lingers on their provoking.
en.B: Surely mockers surround me, \q and my eye must dwell on their taunts.
en.R: I am surrounded by people who mock me. \q Day and night I have to watch them taunt me.

es.L: Ciertamente burladores [hay] conmigo, \q y en su provocación se detiene mi ojo.
es.B: Ciertamente me rodean burladores, \q y mi ojo tiene que posarse en sus provocaciones.
es.R: Estoy rodeado de gente que se burla de mí. \q Día y noche tengo que ver cómo me provocan.

fr.L: Certes, des moqueurs [sont] avec moi, \q et mon œil s’attarde sur leurs provocations.
fr.B: Oui, des moqueurs m’entourent, \q et mon œil doit s’arrêter sur leurs provocations.
fr.R: Je suis entouré de gens qui se moquent de moi. \q Jour et nuit, je dois les voir me provoquer.

sw.L: Hakika wenye dhihaka [wako] pamoja nami, \q na jicho langu linakaa juu ya uchokozi wao.
sw.B: Hakika wenye dhihaka wamenizunguka, \q na jicho langu linalazimika kukaa juu ya kejeli zao.
sw.R: Nimezungukwa na watu wanaonidhihaki. \q Mchana na usiku ninalazimika kuwatazama wakinikejeli.

vi.L: Thật, những kẻ nhạo báng [ở] với tôi, \q và mắt tôi lưu lại trên sự khiêu khích của họ.
vi.B: Thật vậy, những kẻ nhạo báng vây quanh tôi, \q và mắt tôi phải nhìn mãi những lời khiêu khích của họ.
vi.R: Quanh tôi toàn là những người chế nhạo tôi. \q Ngày đêm tôi phải nhìn họ chế giễu tôi.

ko.L: 참으로 조롱하는 자들이 나와 함께 [있고], \q 내 눈은 그들의 도발 위에 머문다.
ko.B: 참으로 조롱하는 자들이 나를 에워싸니, \q 내 눈은 그들의 빈정거림에 머물 수밖에 없다.
ko.R: 나를 비웃는 사람들이 나를 둘러싸고 있다. \q 밤낮으로 나는 그들이 나를 놀리는 것을 보아야 한다.

pt.L: Certamente zombadores [estão] comigo, \q e o meu olho pernoita na provocação deles.
pt.B: Certamente os zombadores me cercam, \q e os meus olhos têm de pousar nas suas afrontas.
pt.R: Estou cercado de gente que zomba de mim. \q Dia e noite tenho de ver como me provocam.

am.L: በእውነት ፌዘኞች ከእኔ ጋር ናቸው፤ \q ዓይኔም በማበሳጨታቸው ላይ ታድራለች።
am.B: በእርግጥ ፌዘኞች ከበውኛል፤ \q ዓይኔም በስድባቸው ላይ ለማረፍ ተገድዳለች።
am.R: የሚያፌዙብኝ ሰዎች ከበውኛል። \q ቀንና ሌሊት ሲሳለቁብኝ ማየት ግድ ሆኖብኛል።

hi.L: निश्चय ठट्ठा करनेवाले मेरे साथ [हैं], \q और मेरी आँख उनके चिढ़ाने पर टिकी रहती है।
hi.B: सचमुच ठट्ठा करनेवाले मुझे घेरे हुए हैं, \q और मेरी आँख को उनके तानों पर ही टिके रहना पड़ता है।
hi.R: मेरा मज़ाक़ उड़ानेवाले लोग मुझे घेरे हुए हैं। \q दिन-रात मुझे उनके ताने देखने पड़ते हैं।

ru.L: Поистине, насмешники со мной, \q и на их вызове пребывает мой глаз.
ru.B: Поистине, меня окружают насмешники, \q и мой взгляд вынужден видеть их издёвки.
ru.R: Вокруг меня люди, которые надо мной смеются. \q День и ночь я должен смотреть, как они издеваются надо мной.

ja.L: まことに、あざける者たちがわたしと共にいて、 \q わたしの目は彼らの挑発の上にとどまる。
ja.B: 本当に、あざける者たちがわたしを取り囲み、 \q わたしの目は、彼らのののしりを見続けなければならない。
ja.R: わたしの周りは、わたしをばかにする人たちばかりだ。 \q わたしは昼も夜も、彼らのいやみを見ていなければならない。

decisions.choice: surely: a strong statement
decisions.reason: The words are "if not", the form of an oath that means "surely" or "indeed".

decisions.choice: mockers: the friends who ridicule him
decisions.reason: The word means mockery or mockers. Job means the friends, whose speeches he hears as ridicule (12:4; 16:20).

decisions.choice: their provoking: their bitter, hostile words; my eye dwells on them
decisions.reason: The verb (marah) means to be rebellious or contentious; here it is the friends' provocation. The verb "dwell" (lin) means to stay overnight, so Job's eye has to rest on their hostility even through the night.

decisions.choice: Day and night
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the verb "stay overnight" (m3): Job cannot get away from their taunts, day or night.

decisions.choice: "пребывает"
decisions.reason: The verb is "stay overnight"; Literal says "dwells" as the English does, and Readable gives its sense with "день и ночь" (m3).

source.text: שִֽׂימָה־נָּ֭א עָרְבֵ֣נִי עִמָּ֑ךְ מִֽי ה֝֗וּא לְיָדִ֥י יִתָּקֵֽעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Set, please, be surety for me with yourself; who [is] he [that] to my hand will strike himself?

en.L: Lay down [a pledge], please, be surety for me with {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}; \q who is there [that] will strike hands with me?
en.B: Please lay down a pledge for me; stand surety for me with {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}. \q Who else will shake hands to back me?
en.R: Please, God, be my guarantee {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}. \q No one else will agree to back me up.

es.L: Pon [una prenda], te ruego, sé mi fiador ante {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mismo; \q ¿quién [hay] que estreche mi mano?
es.B: Te ruego que des una prenda por mí; sé {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} mismo mi fiador ante {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q ¿Quién más estrechará mi mano para respaldarme?
es.R: Por favor, Dios, sé {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} mismo mi garantía. \q Nadie más quiere respaldarme.

fr.L: Dépose [un gage], je te prie, sois mon garant auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}-même ; \q qui [est-ce] qui frappera dans ma main ?
fr.B: Dépose, je te prie, un gage pour moi ; porte-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} garant pour moi auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}-même. \q Qui d’autre me tapera dans la main pour me soutenir ?
fr.R: Je t’en prie, mon Dieu, sois {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}-même ma garantie. \q Personne d’autre n’accepte de me soutenir.

sw.L: Weka [rehani], tafadhali, uwe mdhamini wangu kwako {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} mwenyewe; \q ni nani atakayepeana mkono nami?
sw.B: Tafadhali, weka rehani kwa ajili yangu; uwe mdhamini wangu mbele zako {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} mwenyewe. \q Ni nani mwingine atakayeshikana nami mkono kunidhamini?
sw.R: Tafadhali, Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} mwenyewe uwe dhamana yangu. \q Hakuna mwingine atakayekubali kunitetea.

vi.L: Xin hãy đặt [của cầm], xin bảo lãnh cho con nơi chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q ai [là người] sẽ bắt tay cam kết với con?
vi.B: Xin Chúa đặt của cầm cho con; xin chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đứng ra bảo lãnh cho con trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Còn ai khác sẽ bắt tay bảo đảm cho con?
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm người bảo lãnh cho con. \q Không còn ai khác chịu đứng ra bênh vực con.

ko.L: 부디 [담보를] 놓아 주십시오. 주님 스스로 주님 앞에서 저의 보증인이 되어 주십시오. \q 누가 제 손을 잡고 [보증해] 주겠습니까?
ko.B: 부디 저를 위해 담보를 놓아 주십시오. 주님께서 친히 주님 앞에서 저의 보증인이 되어 주십시오. \q 그 밖에 누가 손을 잡아 저를 보증하겠습니까?
ko.R: 하나님, 주님께서 직접 제 보증이 되어 주십시오. \q 저를 편들어 줄 사람은 아무도 없습니다.

pt.L: Põe [um penhor], por favor, sê fiador por mim junto a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mesmo; \q quem [é] que baterá na minha mão?
pt.B: Por favor, dá um penhor por mim; sê o meu fiador diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mesmo. \q Quem mais vai apertar a minha mão para me garantir?
pt.R: Por favor, ó Deus, sê {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mesmo a minha garantia. \q Ninguém mais vai querer me apoiar.

am.L: እባክህ፣ [መያዣ] አኑር፤ በአንተ ዘንድ ዋስ ሁነኝ፤ \q ከእኔ ጋር እጅ የሚመታ ማን አለ?
am.B: እባክህ፣ ስለ እኔ መያዣ አኑር፤ በአንተ ዘንድ ዋስ ሁነኝ። \q ሌላ ማን እጄን ጨብጦ ዋስ ይሆነኛል?
am.R: አምላክ ሆይ፣ እባክህ አንተው ራስህ ዋስ ሁነኝ። \q ሌላ ማንም ዋስ ሊሆነኝ አይፈቅድም።

hi.L: कृपया [ज़मानत] रख, अपने ही पास मेरा ज़ामिन बन; \q कौन है [जो] मेरे हाथ पर हाथ मारेगा?
hi.B: कृपया मेरे लिए ज़मानत रख; अपने ही पास मेरा ज़ामिन बन। \q और कौन मेरी ज़मानत के लिए मुझसे हाथ मिलाएगा?
hi.R: हे परमेश्वर, कृपया तू ख़ुद मेरी ज़मानत दे। \q और कोई मेरा साथ देने को तैयार नहीं है।

ru.L: Положи [залог], прошу, поручись за меня перед собой; \q кто тот, [кто] ударит со мной по рукам?
ru.B: Прошу, дай за меня залог; поручись за меня сам перед собой. \q Кто ещё ударит со мной по рукам, чтобы поручиться?
ru.R: Боже, прошу, будь сам моим поручителем. \q Никто другой не согласится за меня поручиться.

ja.L: どうか、[保証を]置いてほしい。あなた自身のもとで、わたしの保証人となってほしい。 \q だれが、わたしと手を打ってくれるだろうか？
ja.B: どうか、わたしのために保証を置き、あなた自身のもとで、わたしの保証人となってほしい。 \q ほかのだれが、手を打ってわたしを保証してくれるだろうか？
ja.R: 神よ、どうか、あなた自身がわたしの保証人になってほしい。 \q ほかにだれも、わたしの味方になってくれる人はいない。

decisions.choice: Job speaks to God
alternatives: Job speaks to one of the friends
decisions.reason: The verbs are singular commands, and "with yourself" means the one who holds the case. Job asks God himself to stand guarantee for him before God, as he looked for a witness in heaven (16:19-21). No human will do it, as the next line says.

decisions.choice: be surety; strike hands: to guarantee another's debt
decisions.reason: To "stand surety" was to make oneself responsible for another person's debt or case, and the agreement was sealed by a handshake (Proverbs 6:1; 17:18; 22:26). Job asks for someone to vouch for him in his case.

decisions.choice: set: lay down a pledge
decisions.reason: The first verb, "set" or "put", has no object. The parallel with "be surety" shows that a pledge is meant, a security handed over for someone.

decisions.choice: Please, God, be my guarantee yourself
decisions.reason: Readable names God (m1) and puts the legal picture of a pledge and a handshake (m2) in plain words.

decisions.choice: Job speaks to God as "Chúa" and "Ngài" and calls himself "con" in verses 3-4, against "tôi" in the rest of the speech
decisions.reason: As in the laments of the Psalms, a speaker praying to God calls himself "con". Job's speech is bitter, and "tôi" would keep his voice the same throughout; a reviewer should choose.

decisions.choice: 합쇼체 with 주님 and 저 when Job turns to God
decisions.reason: Job speaks to God here (meaning decision m1), and Korean prayer uses 합쇼체 with 저/제, as in the Psalms; the verses around it are in the plain style.

decisions.choice: "penhor", "fiador", "bater na mão" (L), "apertar a mão" (B); "a minha garantia", "me apoiar" (R)
decisions.reason: "Fiador" is the ordinary Portuguese word for one who answers for another's debt, and "penhor" for the security handed over, the legal picture of m2. Literal keeps the handshake as the Hebrew has it; Balanced makes it the familiar gesture of closing a deal; Readable says the sense plainly, as the English does. Job speaks to God here (m1), so the commands are in the "tu" form ("põe", "dá", "sê").

decisions.choice: be surety as "ዋስ ሁነኝ"; strike hands as "እጅ የሚመታ" (L)
decisions.reason: "ዋስ" is the ordinary word for one who guarantees another's debt. Literal keeps the handshake that sealed it ("እጅ መምታት"); Balanced says "እጄን ጨብጦ ዋስ ይሆነኛል" so the gesture is understood.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi. Respect for God is carried by the address "तू" of prayer and by the honorific third person ("उन्होंने", verse 6) at every level.

decisions.choice: "ज़ामिन", "ज़मानत"; "हाथ पर हाथ मारना" (L), "हाथ मिलाना" (B)
decisions.reason: Standing surety for another's debt (m2) is "ज़मानत देना" in everyday Hindi, and the one who stands surety is the "ज़ामिन". Literal keeps the gesture of striking hands that sealed the pledge.

decisions.choice: "собой", "сам" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Where the English has a span on "yourself", Russian uses the reflexive "перед собой" and "сам", which take no span by the style guide.

decisions.choice: Job's plea to God as "〜てほしい" ("保証人となってほしい")
decisions.reason: Job book convention (JOB-1 notes, 7:7 onward) for requests to God in the plain-style dialogues.

records.literal_gloss: For their heart you have hidden from understanding; therefore not you will exalt [them].

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have hidden their heart from understanding; \q therefore {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not exalt [them].
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have closed their minds to understanding; \q therefore {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not let them triumph.
en.R: You have kept my friends from understanding. \q So {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not let them win.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has escondido su corazón del entendimiento; \q por eso no [los] exaltarás.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has cerrado su mente al entendimiento; \q por eso no los dejarás triunfar.
es.R: Tú no has dejado que mis amigos entiendan. \q Por eso {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no dejarás que ganen.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as caché leur cœur à l’intelligence ; \q c’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne [les] élèveras pas.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fermé leur esprit à l’intelligence ; \q c’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne les laisseras pas triompher.
fr.R: Tu as empêché mes amis de comprendre. \q Alors {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne les laisseras pas gagner.

sw.L: Kwa maana umeuficha moyo wao usipate ufahamu; \q kwa hiyo hutawatukuza.
sw.B: Kwa maana umeifunga mioyo yao isielewe; \q kwa hiyo hutawaacha washinde.
sw.R: Umewazuia rafiki zangu wasielewe. \q Kwa hiyo hutawaacha washinde.

vi.L: Vì Chúa đã giấu lòng họ khỏi sự hiểu biết; \q vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không tôn cao [họ].
vi.B: Vì Chúa đã đóng trí họ lại, không cho họ hiểu biết; \q vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không để họ đắc thắng.
vi.R: Chúa đã không cho bạn bè của con hiểu biết. \q Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không để họ thắng.

ko.L: 주님께서 그들의 마음을 가리어 깨닫지 못하게 하셨으니, \q 그러므로 주님께서 [그들을] 높이지 않으실 것입니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 그들의 마음을 닫아 깨닫지 못하게 하셨으니, \q 그들이 이기게 두지 않으실 것입니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 제 친구들이 깨닫지 못하게 하셨습니다. \q 그러니 주님께서 그들이 이기게 두지 않으실 것입니다.

pt.L: Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} escondeste o coração deles do entendimento; \q por isso não [os] exaltarás.
pt.B: Pois fechaste a mente deles para o entendimento; \q por isso não deixarás que triunfem.
pt.R: Tu impediste os meus amigos de entender. \q Por isso não vais deixar que eles vençam.

am.L: ልባቸውን ከማስተዋል ሰውረሃልና፤ \q ስለዚህ ከፍ አታደርግ[ቸውም]።
am.B: አእምሮአቸውን ለማስተዋል ዘግተሃልና፤ \q ስለዚህ እንዲያሸንፉ አትፈቅድላቸውም።
am.R: ወዳጆቼ እንዳያስተውሉ ከልክለሃቸዋል። \q ስለዚህ እንዲያሸንፉ አትፈቅድላቸውም።

hi.L: क्योंकि तूने उनके मन को समझ से छिपा रखा है; \q इसलिए तू [उन्हें] ऊँचा नहीं करेगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि तूने उनकी बुद्धि को समझ के लिए बंद कर दिया है; \q इसलिए तू उन्हें जीतने नहीं देगा।
hi.R: तूने मेरे दोस्तों को समझ से दूर रखा है। \q इसलिए तू उन्हें जीतने नहीं देगा।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} скрыл их сердце от разумения; \q поэтому {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} не возвысишь [их].
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} закрыл их ум для понимания; \q поэтому {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} не дашь им восторжествовать.
ru.R: Ты не дал моим друзьям понять правду. \q Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} не дашь им победить.

ja.L: あなたが彼らの心を悟りから隠されたからだ。 \q それゆえ、あなたは[彼らを]高くはなさらない。
ja.B: あなたは彼らの心を閉ざして、悟ることができないようにされた。 \q だから、彼らに勝ち誇らせることはなさらない。
ja.R: あなたは、わたしの友人たちが悟れないようにされた。 \q だから、彼らを勝たせることはなさらない。

decisions.choice: their: the friends
decisions.reason: The "they" of these verses are the mockers of verse 2, the friends. Job still speaks to God (verse 3).

decisions.choice: heart: the mind
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the heart is the seat of thought and understanding, so a heart kept from understanding is a closed mind (12:24).

decisions.choice: you will not exalt them: you will not let them win
decisions.reason: The verb has no object. With "them" understood, Job says God will not let the friends come out on top in the dispute, since they do not understand.

decisions.choice: my friends
decisions.reason: Readable names the friends (m1).

source.text: לְ֭חֵלֶק יַגִּ֣יד רֵעִ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו תִּכְלֶֽנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: For a share he informs [on] friends, and the eyes of his children will fail.

en.L: For a share one denounces friends, \q and the eyes of his children will fail.
en.B: Whoever betrays friends for a share of the spoil, \q the eyes of that person's children will fail.
en.R: When people turn against their friends to get something for themselves, \q their children waste away.

es.L: Por una porción uno delata a los amigos, \q y los ojos de sus hijos desfallecerán.
es.B: Quien traiciona a sus amigos por una parte del botín \q verá desfallecer los ojos de sus hijos.
es.R: Cuando alguien traiciona a sus amigos para sacar provecho, \q sus hijos se consumen.

fr.L: Pour une part on dénonce des amis, \q et les yeux de ses enfants défailliront.
fr.B: Celui qui livre ses amis pour une part du butin, \q les yeux de ses enfants s’éteindront.
fr.R: Quand quelqu’un trahit ses amis pour en tirer profit, \q ce sont ses enfants qui dépérissent.

sw.L: Kwa ajili ya fungu mtu huwashtaki rafiki, \q na macho ya watoto wake yatafifia.
sw.B: Mtu anayewasaliti rafiki zake ili apate sehemu ya nyara, \q macho ya watoto wake yatafifia.
sw.R: Watu wanapowageuka rafiki zao ili wajipatie faida, \q watoto wao hudhoofika.

vi.L: Vì một phần [chia] người ta tố cáo bạn bè, \q và mắt con cái người ấy sẽ mờ đi.
vi.B: Kẻ nào phản bội bạn bè để được chia phần, \q thì mắt con cái kẻ ấy sẽ mờ đi.
vi.R: Khi người ta quay lưng với bạn bè để kiếm lợi cho mình, \q thì con cái họ sẽ héo mòn.

ko.L: 몫을 얻으려고 친구들을 고발하는 자는, \q 그 자식들의 눈이 흐려질 것이다.
ko.B: 몫을 얻으려고 친구를 팔아넘기는 사람은 \q 그 자식들의 눈이 흐려질 것이다.
ko.R: 자기 이익을 위해 친구를 배신하면 \q 그 자녀들이 시들어 간다.

pt.L: Por uma parte [alguém] denuncia amigos, \q e os olhos dos seus filhos desfalecerão.
pt.B: Quem trai os amigos por uma parte do despojo \q verá desfalecer os olhos dos próprios filhos.
pt.R: Quando alguém se volta contra os amigos para ganhar alguma coisa, \q os filhos dessa pessoa definham.

am.L: ለድርሻ ብሎ ወዳጆችን ያወግዛል፤ \q የልጆቹም ዓይኖች ይደክማሉ።
am.B: ከምርኮ ድርሻ ለማግኘት ወዳጆቹን አሳልፎ የሚሰጥ ሰው፣ \q የዚያ ሰው ልጆች ዓይኖች ይደክማሉ።
am.R: ሰዎች ለራሳቸው ጥቅም ብለው ወዳጆቻቸውን ሲከዱ፣ \q ልጆቻቸው ይመነምናሉ።

hi.L: हिस्से के लिए कोई मित्रों पर दोष लगाता है, \q और उसके बच्चों की आँखें धुँधला जाएँगी।
hi.B: जो लूट में हिस्सा पाने के लिए मित्रों से विश्वासघात करता है, \q उसके बच्चों की आँखें धुँधला जाएँगी।
hi.R: जब लोग अपने फ़ायदे के लिए अपने दोस्तों के ख़िलाफ़ हो जाते हैं, \q तो उनके बच्चे घुल-घुलकर मिट जाते हैं।

ru.L: За долю доносит [он] на друзей, \q и глаза его детей угаснут.
ru.B: Кто предаёт друзей ради доли в добыче, \q у того дети угаснут.
ru.R: Когда человек предаёт друзей ради собственной выгоды, \q его дети чахнут.

ja.L: 分け前のために友を告げ口する者、 \q その子らの目は衰える。
ja.B: 分け前を得るために友を裏切る者は、 \q その子どもたちの目が衰える。
ja.R: 自分が得をするために友だちを裏切る人がいると、 \q その子どもたちが、やせ衰えてしまう。

decisions.choice: for a share one denounces friends: betrays friends for gain
alternatives: he invites friends to a share (of a meal) while his own children's eyes fail with hunger
decisions.reason: This line reads like a proverb and is hard. Most likely it speaks of someone who informs on friends to get a share of their property, and says that his children will suffer for it. It can also be read as a man who invites friends to share a meal while his own children go hungry. Either way Job warns the friends that turning on him will rebound on them.

decisions.choice: the eyes fail: waste away, lose hope and strength
decisions.reason: Eyes that "fail" or grow dim belong to one who is starving, sick or without hope (11:20; Psalm 69:4).

decisions.choice: that person's children (B), their children (R)
decisions.reason: The saying is about anyone who acts this way, so Balanced and Readable do not use "his".

decisions.choice: "sus hijos" for "his children"
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" already covers sons and daughters, and "quien", "alguien" are not marked for sex, so Spanish needs no gender setting where the English Balanced and Readable avoid "his".

source.text: וְֽ֭הִצִּגַנִי לִמְשֹׁ֣ל עַמִּ֑ים וְתֹ֖פֶת לְפָנִ֣ים אֶֽהְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he has set me for a byword of peoples, and a spitting to [the] face I am.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has set me as a byword of [the] peoples, \q and I am [one] spat on in [the] face.
en.B: He has made me a byword among the peoples, \q someone people spit on in the face.
en.R: God has made me a joke to everyone. \q People spit in my face.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me ha puesto por refrán de [los] pueblos, \q y soy [alguien a quien] escupen en [la] cara.
es.B: Me ha convertido en refrán entre los pueblos, \q alguien a quien la gente escupe en la cara.
es.R: Dios ha hecho de mí el hazmerreír de todos. \q La gente me escupe en la cara.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a établi en proverbe pour [les] peuples, \q et je suis [quelqu’un à qui l’on] crache au visage.
fr.B: Il a fait de moi un proverbe parmi les peuples, \q quelqu’un à qui l’on crache au visage.
fr.R: Dieu a fait de moi la risée de tout le monde. \q Les gens me crachent au visage.

sw.L: Naye amenifanya kuwa mithali ya mataifa, \q nami ni [mtu wa] kutemewa mate usoni.
sw.B: Amenifanya kuwa methali kati ya mataifa, \q mtu ambaye watu humtemea mate usoni.
sw.R: Mungu amenifanya kuwa kichekesho kwa kila mtu. \q Watu wananitemea mate usoni.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt tôi làm câu tục ngữ cho [các] dân, \q và tôi là [kẻ] bị nhổ vào mặt.
vi.B: Ngài đã biến tôi thành câu cửa miệng giữa các dân, \q thành kẻ bị người ta nhổ vào mặt.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho tôi thành trò cười cho mọi người. \q Người ta nhổ vào mặt tôi.

ko.L: 그분께서 나를 뭇 백성의 속담거리로 삼으셨으니, \q 나는 얼굴에 침 뱉음을 당하는 [자가] 되었다.
ko.B: 그분께서 나를 뭇 민족의 입에 오르내리는 이야깃거리로 삼으셨고, \q 나는 사람들이 얼굴에 침을 뱉는 사람이 되었다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 나를 모든 사람의 놀림거리로 만드셨다. \q 사람들이 내 얼굴에 침을 뱉는다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me pôs como provérbio dos povos, \q e eu sou [alguém] cuspido no rosto.
pt.B: Ele fez de mim um provérbio entre os povos, \q alguém em cujo rosto se cospe.
pt.R: Deus fez de mim motivo de piada para todos. \q As pessoas cospem na minha cara.

am.L: ለሕዝቦችም መተረቻ አደረገኝ፤ \q ፊቱ ላይ የሚተፋበትም ሆኛለሁ።
am.B: በሕዝቦች መካከል መተረቻ አደረገኝ፤ \q ሰዎች ፊቱ ላይ የሚተፉበት ሰው ሆኛለሁ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ለሰው ሁሉ መሳለቂያ አደረገኝ። \q ሰዎች ፊቴ ላይ ይተፋሉ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने मुझे लोगों के लिए कहावत बना दिया है, \q और मैं [ऐसा] हूँ [जिसके] मुँह पर थूका जाता है।
hi.B: उन्होंने मुझे देश-देश के लोगों में कहावत बना दिया है, \q ऐसा आदमी जिसके मुँह पर लोग थूकते हैं।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ने मुझे सबके लिए मज़ाक़ बना दिया है। \q लोग मेरे मुँह पर थूकते हैं।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поставил меня притчей народов, \q и [тем, кому] плюют в лицо, я стал.
ru.B: Он сделал меня притчей во языцех среди народов, \q человеком, которому плюют в лицо.
ru.R: Бог сделал меня посмешищем для всех. \q Люди плюют мне в лицо.

ja.L: その方はわたしを、もろもろの民のことわざとされ、 \q わたしは顔につばを吐きかけられる者となった。
ja.B: その方はわたしを、人々の物笑いの種とされた。 \q わたしは、人々が顔につばを吐きかける者だ。
ja.R: 神は、わたしをみんなの笑い者にされた。 \q 人々は、わたしの顔につばを吐きかける。

decisions.choice: he: God
decisions.reason: As in 16:7-14, the "he" who acts against Job is God.

decisions.choice: a byword: a name used as an example of disaster
decisions.reason: To become a byword is to have one's name used in sayings about ruin (Deuteronomy 28:37; Psalm 44:15).

decisions.choice: a spitting: one spat on, the deepest contempt
decisions.reason: The word (tophet) means a spitting. To be spat on in the face was utter disgrace (30:10; Numbers 12:14; Isaiah 50:6). It is not the place name Topheth.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names God (m1).

decisions.choice: 그분께서 ... 삼으셨다, with the honorific, for God spoken of in the third person
alternatives: a bare verb with no subject
decisions.reason: Korean has no deity_pronoun spans; respect for God is carried by 그분, 께서 and -시-, as the Korean style guide says, even where Job complains of what God has done to him.

decisions.choice: "притчей во языцех"
decisions.reason: A byword is a name everyone uses as an example of disaster (m2); the Russian idiom says exactly that and keeps "peoples".

source.text: וַתֵּ֣כַהּ מִכַּ֣עַשׂ עֵינִ֑י וִֽיצֻרַ֖י כַּצֵּ֣ל כֻּלָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And has grown dim from grief my eye, and my members [are] like the shadow all of them.

en.L: And my eye has grown dim from grief, \q and my limbs [are] like a shadow, all of them.
en.B: My eye has grown dim with grief, \q and my whole body is like a shadow.
en.R: My eyes have grown weak with sorrow, \q and my body has wasted away to a shadow.

es.L: Y se ha oscurecido mi ojo por la aflicción, \q y mis miembros [son] como sombra, todos ellos.
es.B: Mi ojo se ha nublado de pena, \q y todo mi cuerpo es como una sombra.
es.R: Mis ojos se han debilitado de tanta tristeza, \q y mi cuerpo se ha consumido hasta quedar como una sombra.

fr.L: Et mon œil s’est obscurci de chagrin, \q et mes membres [sont] comme l’ombre, tous.
fr.B: Mon œil s’est éteint de chagrin, \q et tout mon corps n’est plus qu’une ombre.
fr.R: Mes yeux sont usés par la tristesse, \q et mon corps a fondu au point de n’être plus qu’une ombre.

sw.L: Na jicho langu limefifia kwa huzuni, \q na viungo vyangu [ni] kama kivuli, vyote.
sw.B: Jicho langu limefifia kwa huzuni, \q na mwili wangu wote ni kama kivuli.
sw.R: Macho yangu yamedhoofika kwa huzuni, \q na mwili wangu umekonda hata kuwa kama kivuli.

vi.L: Và mắt tôi đã mờ đi vì sầu khổ, \q và các chi thể tôi [như] cái bóng, tất cả.
vi.B: Mắt tôi đã mờ vì sầu muộn, \q toàn thân tôi như một cái bóng.
vi.R: Mắt tôi yếu đi vì buồn rầu, \q thân thể tôi gầy mòn chỉ còn như cái bóng.

ko.L: 내 눈은 근심으로 흐려졌고, \q 내 지체는 모두 그림자 같다.
ko.B: 내 눈은 슬픔으로 침침해졌고, \q 내 온몸은 그림자처럼 되었다.
ko.R: 슬픔 때문에 내 눈이 약해졌고, \q 내 몸은 말라서 그림자처럼 되었다.

pt.L: E o meu olho se escureceu de desgosto, \q e os meus membros [são] como a sombra, todos eles.
pt.B: A minha vista se turvou de desgosto, \q e o meu corpo inteiro é como uma sombra.
pt.R: Os meus olhos ficaram fracos de tanta tristeza, \q e o meu corpo se reduziu a uma sombra.

am.L: ዓይኔም ከሐዘን የተነሣ ደከመች፤ \q የአካሌም ክፍሎች ሁሉ እንደ ጥላ ናቸው።
am.B: ዓይኔ በሐዘን ደክማለች፤ \q መላ ሰውነቴም እንደ ጥላ ሆኗል።
am.R: ዓይኖቼ ከሐዘን የተነሣ ደክመዋል፤ \q ሰውነቴም መንምኖ እንደ ጥላ ሆኗል።

hi.L: और दुःख से मेरी आँख धुँधली हो गई है, \q और मेरे अंग सब के सब छाया के समान [हैं]।
hi.B: शोक से मेरी आँख धुँधली हो गई है, \q और मेरा सारा शरीर छाया-सा हो गया है।
hi.R: दुःख के मारे मेरी आँखें कमज़ोर हो गई हैं, \q और मेरा शरीर सूखकर छाया-सा रह गया है।

ru.L: И потускнел от скорби мой глаз, \q и мои члены — как тень, все они.
ru.B: Мой глаз потускнел от горя, \q и всё моё тело — как тень.
ru.R: Мои глаза ослабели от печали, \q а тело стало тонким, как тень.

ja.L: わたしの目は悲しみのためにかすみ、 \q わたしの四肢は皆、影のようだ。
ja.B: わたしの目は悲しみでかすみ、 \q わたしの体全体が影のようだ。
ja.R: 悲しみのために、わたしの目は弱り、 \q わたしの体はやせ細って、影のようになった。

decisions.choice: grief: sorrow mixed with vexation
decisions.reason: The word (ka'as) covers vexation, anger and grief (5:2; 6:2). Here it is the misery that has worn Job out.

decisions.choice: my limbs: the parts of my body
decisions.reason: The rare word means "formed things", the members of the body that God shaped (10:8-11).

decisions.choice: like a shadow: wasted, thin, without substance
decisions.reason: Job's body has shrunk to almost nothing (16:8; 19:20).

decisions.choice: my whole body (B), my body (R)
decisions.reason: "All my limbs" means the whole body, which Balanced and Readable say directly.

decisions.choice: my limbs as "የአካሌ ክፍሎች"
decisions.reason: As the Amharic New Testament settled it, the parts of the body are "ክፍሎች"; "ብልት" now usually means the genitals.

source.text: יָשֹׁ֣מּוּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים עַל־זֹ֑את וְ֝נָקִ֗י עַל־חָנֵ֥ף יִתְעֹרָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Are appalled [the] upright at this, and [the] innocent against [the] godless rouses himself.

en.L: The upright are appalled at this, \q and the innocent rouses himself against the godless.
en.B: Upright people are appalled at this, \q and the innocent are stirred up against the godless.
en.R: Honest people are shocked by what has happened to me, \q and the innocent are angry at the godless.

es.L: Los rectos se espantan de esto, \q y el inocente se levanta contra el impío.
es.B: Los rectos se horrorizan ante esto, \q y los inocentes se indignan contra los impíos.
es.R: La gente honrada se escandaliza de lo que me ha pasado, \q y los inocentes se enojan con los impíos.

fr.L: Les hommes droits sont stupéfaits de cela, \q et l’innocent s’irrite contre l’impie.
fr.B: Les hommes droits en sont consternés, \q et les innocents s’indignent contre les impies.
fr.R: Les gens honnêtes sont choqués par ce qui m’arrive, \q et les innocents s’indignent contre ceux qui ne respectent pas Dieu.

sw.L: Wanyofu wanashangaa kwa hili, \q na asiye na hatia anajiamsha juu ya asiyemcha Mungu.
sw.B: Watu wanyofu wanashtushwa na hili, \q na wasio na hatia wanachukizwa na wasiomcha Mungu.
sw.R: Watu waaminifu wanashtushwa na yaliyonipata, \q na wasio na hatia wanawakasirikia wasiomjali Mungu.

vi.L: Những người ngay thẳng kinh ngạc về điều này, \q và người vô tội nổi lên chống lại kẻ vô đạo.
vi.B: Người ngay thẳng sững sờ trước điều này, \q và người vô tội phẫn nộ với kẻ vô đạo.
vi.R: Những người lương thiện bàng hoàng trước những gì xảy đến cho tôi, \q và người vô tội nổi giận với những kẻ không kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 정직한 사람들이 이 일로 놀라고, \q 죄 없는 사람은 경건하지 않은 자를 대항하여 일어선다.
ko.B: 정직한 사람들은 이 일에 경악하고, \q 죄 없는 사람들은 경건하지 않은 자들에게 분개한다.
ko.R: 정직한 사람들은 나에게 일어난 일을 보고 충격을 받고, \q 죄 없는 사람들은 하나님을 무시하는 자들에게 화를 낸다.

pt.L: Os retos ficam pasmos com isto, \q e o inocente se levanta contra o ímpio.
pt.B: As pessoas retas ficam espantadas com isso, \q e os inocentes se revoltam contra os ímpios.
pt.R: As pessoas honestas ficam chocadas com o que aconteceu comigo, \q e os inocentes ficam indignados com quem vive sem Deus.

am.L: ቅኖች በዚህ ይደነግጣሉ፤ \q ንጹሑም በዝንጉ ላይ ይነሣሣል።
am.B: ቅን ሰዎች በዚህ ይደነግጣሉ፤ \q ንጹሓንም በዝንጉ ሰዎች ላይ ይነሣሣሉ።
am.R: ቅን ሰዎች በደረሰብኝ ነገር ይደነግጣሉ፤ \q ንጹሓንም እግዚአብሔርን በማይፈሩ ሰዎች ላይ ይቆጣሉ።

hi.L: सीधे लोग इस पर चकित होते हैं, \q और निर्दोष भक्तिहीन के विरुद्ध भड़क उठता है।
hi.B: सीधे लोग यह देखकर दंग रह जाते हैं, \q और निर्दोष लोग भक्तिहीनों के विरुद्ध भड़क उठते हैं।
hi.R: ईमानदार लोग मेरा हाल देखकर हैरान हैं, \q और निर्दोष लोग भक्तिहीनों पर क्रोधित हैं।

ru.L: Изумляются прямодушные этому, \q и невинный против нечестивца поднимается.
ru.B: Прямодушные ужасаются этому, \q и невинные восстают против безбожников.
ru.R: Честные люди потрясены тем, что случилось со мной, \q и невинные гневаются на безбожников.

ja.L: まっすぐな者たちはこれに驚きあきれ、 \q 罪のない者は神を敬わない者に対して奮い立つ。
ja.B: まっすぐな人々はこれを見て驚きあきれ、 \q 罪のない人は神を敬わない者に対して憤る。
ja.R: 正直な人たちは、わたしに起きたことを見てショックを受け、 \q 罪のない人は、神を敬わない人に腹を立てる。

decisions.choice: this: what has happened to Job
decisions.reason: "This" points back to Job's suffering and disgrace in verses 6-7.

decisions.choice: the godless: one who has turned away from God
decisions.reason: The word (chanef) means a person who is profane or godless, one who has left God (8:13; 13:16; 15:34).

decisions.choice: Job's own conviction that the upright stand firm
alternatives: Job ironically echoes what the friends would say
decisions.reason: Verses 8-9 break into Job's lament. Most likely Job says that right-minded people are shocked at his treatment and keep to their way, and he counts himself among them. Some read the lines as ironic, quoting the friends' teaching back at them, but nothing in the words marks them as a quotation.

decisions.choice: by what has happened to me
decisions.reason: Readable says what "this" refers to (m1).

decisions.choice: "भक्तिहीन"
decisions.reason: The godless (chanef) are those who have turned away from God (m2); "भक्तिहीन" says this, and is the book's word for them at every level (8:13, 27:8, 34:30). "सीधे लोग" for the upright as the poetry note gives.

decisions.choice: "нечестивец" (L), "безбожник" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is one who has turned away from God (m2), not the usual word for "the wicked"; as through the book, Literal says "нечестивец" and Balanced and Readable "безбожник", apart from "нечестивые" and "злые люди". The Synodal "лицемер" narrows the sense.

source.text: וְיֹאחֵ֣ז צַדִּ֣יק דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּֽטֳהָר־יָ֝דַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף אֹֽמֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And holds [the] righteous his way, and [the] clean of hands increases strength.

en.L: And the righteous holds to his way, \q and the clean of hands increases [in] strength.
en.B: The righteous hold to their way, \q and those with clean hands grow stronger and stronger.
en.R: Righteous people keep going on their way, \q and those who do no wrong grow stronger.

es.L: Y el justo se aferra a su camino, \q y el limpio de manos aumenta [en] fuerza.
es.B: Los justos se mantienen en su camino, \q y los de manos limpias se fortalecen más y más.
es.R: Las personas justas siguen adelante en su camino, \q y los que no hacen mal se vuelven más fuertes.

fr.L: Et le juste tient son chemin, \q et [celui qui est] pur de mains accroît [sa] force.
fr.B: Les justes s’attachent à leur chemin, \q et ceux qui ont les mains pures deviennent de plus en plus forts.
fr.R: Ceux qui sont justes continuent leur route, \q et ceux qui ne font pas le mal deviennent plus forts.

sw.L: Na mwenye haki anaishika njia yake, \q na mwenye mikono safi anaongezeka [katika] nguvu.
sw.B: Wenye haki wanaishika njia yao, \q na wenye mikono safi wanazidi kuwa na nguvu.
sw.R: Watu wenye haki wanaendelea katika njia yao, \q na wale wasiotenda mabaya wanazidi kupata nguvu.

vi.L: Và người công chính giữ vững đường mình, \q và người có tay trong sạch gia tăng sức mạnh.
vi.B: Người công chính giữ vững đường lối mình, \q người có tay trong sạch ngày càng thêm mạnh mẽ.
vi.R: Người công chính cứ tiếp tục bước đi trên đường của mình, \q và những ai không làm điều sai trái càng thêm vững mạnh.

ko.L: 의인은 자기 길을 굳게 붙들고, \q 손이 깨끗한 자는 힘을 더해 간다.
ko.B: 의인은 자기 길을 굳게 지키고, \q 손이 깨끗한 사람은 점점 더 강해진다.
ko.R: 바르게 사는 사람은 자기 길을 계속 걸어가고, \q 잘못을 저지르지 않는 사람은 더욱 강해진다.

pt.L: E o justo se apega ao seu caminho, \q e o de mãos limpas aumenta [em] força.
pt.B: Os justos se mantêm no seu caminho, \q e os que têm mãos limpas ficam cada vez mais fortes.
pt.R: As pessoas justas continuam no seu caminho, \q e quem não faz nada de errado fica cada vez mais forte.

am.L: ጻድቁም መንገዱን ይይዛል፤ \q እጆቹ ንጹሕ የሆኑም ብርታትን ይጨምራል።
am.B: ጻድቃን መንገዳቸውን አጥብቀው ይይዛሉ፤ \q እጆቻቸው ንጹሕ የሆኑም እየበረቱ ይሄዳሉ።
am.R: ጻድቃን በመንገዳቸው መሄዳቸውን ይቀጥላሉ፤ \q ምንም በደል የማይሠሩም ይበረታሉ።

hi.L: और धर्मी अपने मार्ग को थामे रहता है, \q और शुद्ध हाथोंवाला बल [में] बढ़ता जाता है।
hi.B: धर्मी अपने मार्ग पर बने रहते हैं, \q और जिनके हाथ शुद्ध हैं, वे अधिक से अधिक बलवान होते जाते हैं।
hi.R: धर्मी लोग अपने रास्ते पर चलते रहते हैं, \q और जो कोई ग़लत काम नहीं करते, वे और मज़बूत होते जाते हैं।

ru.L: И держится праведный своего пути, \q и чистый руками прибавляет силы.
ru.B: Праведные держатся своего пути, \q и те, у кого чистые руки, становятся всё сильнее.
ru.R: Праведные люди идут своим путём, \q а те, кто не делает зла, становятся сильнее.

ja.L: そして、正しい者は自分の道を保ち、 \q 手の清い者は力を増し加える。
ja.B: 正しい人々は自分の道を守り続け、 \q 手の清い人々は、ますます強くなる。
ja.R: 正しい人たちは、自分の道を歩み続け、 \q 悪いことをしない人たちは、もっと強くなる。

decisions.choice: the righteous: one who does right and is in the right
decisions.reason: The righteous (tsaddiq) are those who live rightly and so are in the right before God and people.

decisions.choice: clean of hands: innocent in what one does
decisions.reason: Hands stand for a person's deeds; clean hands mean innocent conduct (Psalm 24:4; Job 22:30).

decisions.choice: holds his way; increases strength: keeps going and grows stronger
decisions.reason: To hold one's way is to keep to the path one has chosen without turning aside. Suffering does not make the righteous give up; it makes them stronger.

decisions.choice: the righteous hold to their way (plural)
alternatives: the righteous holds to his way
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses a singular for a type of person. Balanced and Readable use a plural so the line speaks of any righteous person, man or woman.

source.text: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם כֻּלָּ֣ם תָּ֭שֻׁבוּ וּבֹ֣אוּ נָ֑א וְלֹֽא־אֶמְצָ֖א בָכֶ֣ם חָכָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: But all of them, you will return and come, please; and not I will find among you a wise [one].

en.L: But all of them, return and come, please; \q and I will not find among you a wise [one].
en.B: But come on, all of you, try again; \q I will not find a wise person among you.
en.R: Go ahead, all of you, come and argue with me again. \q I will not find a wise person among you.

es.L: Pero todos ellos, {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} y {{plural_you:vengan|venid}}, por favor; \q y no hallaré entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} [a ningún] sabio.
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:vengan|venid}}, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:inténtenlo|intentadlo}} otra vez; \q no hallaré entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} a un solo sabio.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} todos, {{plural_you:discutan|discutid}} conmigo otra vez. \q No encontraré entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} a nadie sabio.

fr.L: Mais eux tous, revenez donc et venez ; \q et je ne trouverai pas parmi vous de sage.
fr.B: Mais allez-y, vous tous, recommencez ; \q je ne trouverai pas un sage parmi vous.
fr.R: Allez-y, vous tous, revenez discuter avec moi. \q Je ne trouverai pas une seule personne sage parmi vous.

sw.L: Lakini wao wote, rudini na mje, tafadhali; \q wala sitampata mwenye hekima miongoni mwenu.
sw.B: Lakini njooni, nyote, jaribuni tena; \q sitampata mwenye hekima hata mmoja miongoni mwenu.
sw.R: Haya, nyote, njooni mbishane nami tena. \q Sitampata mtu mwenye hekima miongoni mwenu.

vi.L: Nhưng tất cả họ, hãy trở lại và đến đây; \q và tôi sẽ không tìm thấy [một] người khôn ngoan giữa các anh.
vi.B: Nhưng hãy đến đi, tất cả các anh, hãy thử lại lần nữa; \q tôi sẽ chẳng tìm được một người khôn ngoan nào giữa các anh.
vi.R: Nào, tất cả các anh, hãy đến tranh luận với tôi lần nữa. \q Tôi sẽ không tìm thấy người nào khôn ngoan giữa các anh.

ko.L: 그러나 그들 모두여, 부디 다시 돌아와 보시오. \q 나는 그대들 가운데서 지혜로운 자를 찾지 못할 것이오.
ko.B: 자, 그대들 모두 다시 해 보시오. \q 나는 그대들 가운데서 지혜로운 사람을 하나도 찾지 못할 것이오.
ko.R: 자, 그대들 모두 다시 와서 나와 따져 보시오. \q 그대들 가운데 지혜로운 사람은 하나도 없을 것이오.

pt.L: Mas todos eles, voltem e venham, por favor; \q e eu não acharei entre vocês um sábio.
pt.B: Mas venham, todos vocês, tentem de novo; \q não vou encontrar um sábio entre vocês.
pt.R: Podem vir, todos vocês, venham discutir comigo outra vez. \q Não vou encontrar entre vocês ninguém que seja sábio.

am.L: እናንተ ግን ሁላችሁ፣ እባካችሁ ተመለሱ፤ ኑ፤ \q በመካከላችሁም ጠቢብ አላገኝም።
am.B: በሉ እንግዲህ ሁላችሁም እንደ ገና ሞክሩ፤ \q በመካከላችሁ ጠቢብ ሰው አላገኝም።
am.R: በሉ፣ ሁላችሁም ኑና እንደ ገና ተከራከሩኝ። \q በመካከላችሁ ጥበበኛ ሰው አላገኝም።

hi.L: परन्तु वे सब, कृपया लौटो और आओ; \q और मैं तुम्हारे बीच कोई बुद्धिमान नहीं पाऊँगा।
hi.B: पर आओ, तुम सब फिर से कोशिश करो; \q मुझे तुममें एक भी बुद्धिमान नहीं मिलेगा।
hi.R: चलो, तुम सब आकर फिर मुझसे बहस करो। \q मुझे तुममें एक भी बुद्धिमान आदमी नहीं मिलेगा।

ru.L: Но все они, возвращайтесь и приходите, прошу; \q и не найду я среди вас мудрого.
ru.B: Ну что ж, все вы, попробуйте снова; \q мудрого среди вас я не найду.
ru.R: Давайте, все вы, приходите и спорьте со мной снова. \q Мудрого среди вас я всё равно не найду.

ja.L: しかし、あなたがた皆、どうか、また戻って来るがよい。 \q わたしは、あなたがたの中に知恵ある者を見つけないだろう。
ja.B: さあ、あなたがた皆、もう一度やってみるがいい。 \q わたしは、あなたがたの中に一人の知恵ある者も見いださないだろう。
ja.R: さあ、あなたたちみんな、もう一度わたしと議論しに来るがいい。 \q あなたたちの中に、知恵のある人は一人も見つからないだろう。

decisions.choice: all of them ... you: all of you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "all of them" and then addresses them as "you". Hebrew poetry can shift person like this; the friends are meant, and the line speaks to them.

decisions.choice: return and come: try again, make your case once more
decisions.reason: Job challenges the friends to start their arguments over, as he asked in 6:29, sure that they will have nothing wiser to say.

decisions.choice: a wise one: biting irony
decisions.reason: The friends claim the wisdom of the ages (8:8-10; 15:9-10, 17-18). Job answers that there is not one wise man among them (12:2-3).

decisions.choice: try again (B), come and argue with me again (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "return and come" means here (m2).

source.text: יָמַ֣י עָ֭בְרוּ זִמֹּתַ֣י נִתְּק֑וּ מ֖וֹרָשֵׁ֣י לְבָבִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: My days have passed; my plans have been torn apart, the desires of my heart.

en.L: My days have passed; my plans are torn apart, \q the desires of my heart.
en.B: My days are over; my plans are torn apart, \q the longings of my heart.
en.R: My life is nearly over. My plans are ruined, \q and so is everything my heart longed for.

es.L: Mis días han pasado; mis planes se han roto, \q los deseos de mi corazón.
es.B: Mis días se acabaron; mis planes se han hecho pedazos, \q los anhelos de mi corazón.
es.R: Mi vida casi ha terminado. Mis planes se han arruinado, \q y también todo lo que mi corazón deseaba.

fr.L: Mes jours ont passé ; mes projets sont arrachés, \q les désirs de mon cœur.
fr.B: Mes jours sont finis ; mes projets sont mis en pièces, \q les vœux de mon cœur.
fr.R: Ma vie est presque finie. Mes projets sont ruinés, \q et tout ce que mon cœur désirait aussi.

sw.L: Siku zangu zimepita; mipango yangu imekatika, \q matamanio ya moyo wangu.
sw.B: Siku zangu zimekwisha; mipango yangu imeraruliwa, \q shauku za moyo wangu.
sw.R: Maisha yangu karibu yamekwisha. Mipango yangu imeharibika, \q pamoja na yote ambayo moyo wangu uliyatamani.

vi.L: Các ngày của tôi đã qua; các dự định của tôi bị xé nát, \q [tức là] những ước muốn của lòng tôi.
vi.B: Những ngày đời tôi đã qua; các dự định của tôi tan nát, \q cả những khát khao trong lòng tôi.
vi.R: Đời tôi sắp hết rồi. Mọi dự định của tôi đều tan vỡ, \q cả những điều lòng tôi mong ước cũng vậy.

ko.L: 내 날들은 지나갔고 내 계획들은 찢겼으니, \q 곧 내 마음의 소원들이다.
ko.B: 내 날은 다 지나갔고, 내 계획들, \q 내 마음이 바라던 것들은 찢겨 나갔다.
ko.R: 내 인생은 거의 끝났다. 내 계획들은 무너졌고, \q 내 마음이 바라던 모든 것도 그렇다.

pt.L: Os meus dias passaram; os meus planos estão despedaçados, \q os desejos do meu coração.
pt.B: Os meus dias acabaram; os meus planos se desfizeram, \q os anseios do meu coração.
pt.R: A minha vida está quase no fim. Os meus planos foram arruinados, \q e também tudo o que o meu coração desejava.

am.L: ዘመኔ አለፈ፤ ዕቅዶቼ ተበጣጠሱ፣ \q የልቤ ምኞቶች።
am.B: ዘመኔ አብቅቷል፤ ዕቅዶቼ ተበጣጥሰዋል፣ \q የልቤም ናፍቆቶች።
am.R: ሕይወቴ ሊያበቃ ተቃርቧል። ዕቅዶቼ ከሽፈዋል፤ \q ልቤ የተመኘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ ከስሟል።

hi.L: मेरे दिन बीत गए; मेरी योजनाएँ टूटकर बिखर गई हैं, \q मेरे मन की अभिलाषाएँ।
hi.B: मेरे दिन पूरे हो चुके; मेरी योजनाएँ टूट गई हैं, \q मेरे मन की लालसाएँ भी।
hi.R: मेरा जीवन लगभग ख़त्म हो चुका है। मेरी योजनाएँ मिट्टी में मिल गई हैं, \q और वह सब भी जिसकी मेरा मन लालसा करता था।

ru.L: Мои дни прошли; мои замыслы разорваны, \q желания моего сердца.
ru.B: Мои дни окончены; мои замыслы разрушены, \q то, к чему стремилось моё сердце.
ru.R: Моя жизнь почти окончена. Мои планы рухнули, \q и всё, чего желало моё сердце, тоже.

ja.L: わたしの日々は過ぎ去り、わたしの計画は引き裂かれた、 \q わたしの心の願いは。
ja.B: わたしの日々は終わり、わたしの計画は断ち切られた。 \q わたしの心の願いも。
ja.R: わたしの命は、もう終わりに近い。わたしの計画はだめになった。 \q 心から願っていたことも、みなだめになった。

decisions.choice: plans: purposes, what one intends
decisions.reason: The word (zimmah) usually means a wicked scheme, but here, as in 42:2, a related word means simply a purpose or plan.

decisions.choice: desires of my heart: what my heart held as its own
decisions.reason: The rare word means "possessions". The heart's possessions are its dearest wishes, now torn away with Job's plans.

decisions.choice: my days have passed: my life is ending
decisions.reason: Job speaks of his life as already behind him (7:6; 9:25; 17:1).

decisions.choice: My life is nearly over
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m3).

source.text: לַ֭יְלָה לְי֣וֹם יָשִׂ֑ימוּ א֝֗וֹר קָר֥וֹב מִפְּנֵי־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Night into day they make; light [is] near from [the] face of darkness.

en.L: They make night into day; \q "light [is] near" in the face of darkness.
en.B: They turn night into day: \q "Light is near," they say, in the face of darkness.
en.R: My friends say that night is day. \q When darkness is all around me, they say, "Light will come soon."

es.L: La noche en día convierten; \q «la luz [está] cerca» ante la oscuridad.
es.B: Convierten la noche en día: \q «La luz está cerca», dicen, frente a la oscuridad.
es.R: Mis amigos dicen que la noche es día. \q Cuando la oscuridad me rodea, dicen: «Pronto llegará la luz».

fr.L: La nuit, ils [la] changent en jour ; \q « la lumière [est] proche » face aux ténèbres.
fr.B: Ils changent la nuit en jour : \q « La lumière est proche », disent-ils, face aux ténèbres.
fr.R: Mes amis prétendent que la nuit, c’est le jour. \q Quand je suis entouré de ténèbres, ils disent : « La lumière va bientôt venir. »

sw.L: Usiku wanaugeuza kuwa mchana; \q "nuru [i] karibu" mbele ya giza.
sw.B: Wanaugeuza usiku kuwa mchana: \q "Nuru iko karibu," wanasema, mbele ya giza.
sw.R: Rafiki zangu wanasema usiku ni mchana. \q Giza linaponizunguka, wanasema, "Nuru itakuja upesi."

vi.L: Đêm thì họ biến thành ngày; \q "ánh sáng [thì] gần" trước mặt bóng tối.
vi.B: Họ biến đêm thành ngày: \q "Ánh sáng đã gần," họ nói thế giữa bóng tối.
vi.R: Các bạn tôi bảo rằng đêm là ngày. \q Khi bóng tối vây quanh tôi, họ nói: "Ánh sáng sắp đến rồi."

ko.L: 그들은 밤을 낮으로 바꾸어, \q 어둠 앞에서 "빛이 가깝다" [한다].
ko.B: 그들은 밤을 낮이라 하며, \q 어둠을 앞에 두고 "빛이 가깝다"고 말한다.
ko.R: 내 친구들은 밤을 낮이라고 한다. \q 어둠이 나를 덮고 있는데도 "곧 빛이 올 것이다" 하고 말한다.

pt.L: Eles fazem da noite dia; \q "a luz [está] perto" diante das trevas.
pt.B: Eles transformam a noite em dia: \q "A luz está perto", dizem eles, diante das trevas.
pt.R: Os meus amigos dizem que a noite é dia. \q Quando estou cercado de escuridão, eles dizem: "A luz logo vai chegar."

am.L: ሌሊትን ቀን ያደርጋሉ፤ \q «ብርሃን ቀርቧል» በጨለማ ፊት።
am.B: ሌሊትን ቀን ያደርጋሉ፤ \q በጨለማ ፊት «ብርሃን ቀርቧል» ይላሉ።
am.R: ወዳጆቼ ሌሊቱን ቀን ነው ይላሉ። \q ጨለማ ከቦኝ ሳለ «ብርሃን በቅርቡ ይመጣል» ይላሉ።

hi.L: वे रात को दिन बनाते हैं; \q "उजियाला निकट [है]" अंधकार के सामने।
hi.B: वे रात को दिन बना देते हैं: \q अंधकार के बीच वे कहते हैं, "उजियाला निकट है।"
hi.R: मेरे दोस्त कहते हैं कि रात दिन है। \q जब मेरे चारों ओर अंधेरा है, तब वे कहते हैं, "उजाला जल्दी आएगा।"

ru.L: Ночь в день они обращают; \q «свет близко» перед лицом тьмы.
ru.B: Они превращают ночь в день: \q «Свет близко», — говорят они перед лицом тьмы.
ru.R: Мои друзья называют ночь днём. \q Когда вокруг меня тьма, они говорят: «Скоро будет светло».

ja.L: 彼らは夜を昼に変える。 \q 「光が近い」と闇の前で[言う]。
ja.B: 彼らは夜を昼に変えて、 \q 闇を前にして「光は近い」と言う。
ja.R: わたしの友人たちは、夜を昼だと言う。 \q 暗闇がわたしを包んでいるのに、「もうすぐ光が来る」と言う。

decisions.choice: they: the friends, who promise a bright future
decisions.reason: The most likely subject is the friends. Zophar promised that Job's life would be brighter than noon and his darkness like morning (11:17); Job says they call night day and talk of light while he sits in the dark. The verse can also be read of Job's own tormented thoughts, which turn his nights into days (7:4).

decisions.choice: "light is near": the words of the friends
alternatives: light is near to darkness: light soon gives way to darkness
decisions.reason: The second line has no verb of saying. Read as what "they" say, it matches the first line. It can also mean that light soon turns into darkness.

decisions.choice: they say
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "they say" to show the words are a quotation (m2); Readable also names the friends (m1).

source.text: אִם־אֲ֭קַוֶּה שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתִ֑י בַּ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ רִפַּ֥דְתִּי יְצוּעָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: If I hope [for] Sheol [as] my house, in darkness I have spread my bed,

en.L: If I hope [for] Sheol [as] my home, \q [if] in darkness I spread out my bed,
en.B: If I look for Sheol as my home, \q if I spread out my bed in the dark,
en.R: Suppose the only home I can hope for is the grave, \q and I must make my bed in the dark.

es.L: Si espero el Seol [como] mi casa, \q [si] en las tinieblas tiendo mi lecho,
es.B: Si espero el lugar de los muertos como mi hogar, \q si tiendo mi cama en la oscuridad,
es.R: Supongamos que el único hogar que puedo esperar es el lugar de los muertos, \q y que debo hacer mi cama en la oscuridad.

fr.L: Si j’espère le Shéol [comme] ma maison, \q [si] dans les ténèbres j’étends ma couche,
fr.B: Si j’attends le séjour des morts comme ma demeure, \q si j’étends mon lit dans les ténèbres,
fr.R: Supposons que la seule maison que je puisse espérer soit le séjour des morts, \q et que je doive faire mon lit dans le noir.

sw.L: Nikitarajia Kuzimu [kuwa] nyumba yangu, \q [nikiwa] gizani nimetandika kitanda changu,
sw.B: Ikiwa ninaitazamia Kuzimu kuwa makao yangu, \q ikiwa ninatandika kitanda changu gizani,
sw.R: Tuseme makao pekee ninayoweza kuyatumainia ni Kuzimu, \q na kwamba ni lazima nitandike kitanda changu gizani.

vi.L: Nếu tôi trông đợi Âm Phủ [làm] nhà mình, \q [nếu] tôi trải giường mình trong bóng tối,
vi.B: Nếu tôi trông chờ Âm Phủ làm nhà, \q nếu tôi trải giường trong bóng tối,
vi.R: Giả sử nơi duy nhất tôi có thể trông mong là nơi của người chết, \q và tôi phải nằm ngủ trong bóng tối.

ko.L: 내가 스올을 내 집으로 바란다면, \q 어둠 속에 내 침상을 폈다면,
ko.B: 내가 스올을 내 집으로 기다린다면, \q 어둠 속에 내 잠자리를 편다면,
ko.R: 내가 바랄 수 있는 집이 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳뿐이라고 하자. \q 어둠 속에 내 잠자리를 펴야 한다고 하자.

pt.L: Se espero o Sheol [como] minha casa, \q [se] nas trevas estendo a minha cama,
pt.B: Se espero o mundo dos mortos como meu lar, \q se estendo a minha cama na escuridão,
pt.R: Digamos que o único lar que posso esperar seja o mundo dos mortos \q e que eu tenha de fazer a minha cama no escuro.

am.L: ሲኦልን ቤቴ እንዲሆን ተስፋ ባደርግ፣ \q በጨለማ አልጋዬን ባነጥፍ፣
am.B: የሙታንን ዓለም ቤቴ አድርጌ ብጠብቅ፣ \q አልጋዬን በጨለማ ባነጥፍ፣
am.R: ተስፋ የማደርገው ብቸኛ ቤት የሙታን ዓለም ነው እንበል፤ \q አልጋዬንም በጨለማ ማንጠፍ አለብኝ እንበል።

hi.L: यदि मैं शिओल की [अपने] घर [के रूप में] आशा करूँ, \q [यदि] अंधकार में मैं अपना बिछौना बिछाऊँ,
hi.B: यदि मैं अधोलोक को अपना घर मानकर उसकी बाट जोहूँ, \q यदि अंधेरे में अपना बिछौना बिछाऊँ,
hi.R: मान लो कि मृत्यु का लोक ही वह घर है जिसकी मैं आशा कर सकता हूँ, \q और मुझे अंधेरे में अपना बिस्तर लगाना है।

ru.L: Если я жду шеола [как] своего дома, \q [если] во тьме я постелил свою постель,
ru.B: Если я жду мира мёртвых как своего дома, \q если во тьме я стелю себе постель,
ru.R: Допустим, единственный дом, на который я могу надеяться, — это мир мёртвых, \q и мне придётся постелить себе постель во тьме.

ja.L: もし、わたしが陰府をわたしの家として待ち望み、 \q 闇の中にわたしの寝床を広げるのなら、
ja.B: もし、わたしが陰府をわが家として待ち望み、 \q 暗闇の中に寝床を敷くのなら、
ja.R: 仮に、わたしが望める家は死者の世界だけで、 \q 暗闇の中に寝床を作らなければならないとしよう。

decisions.choice: if: a condition completed in verse 15
decisions.reason: The "if" starts a sentence that runs through verse 14; verse 15 gives the conclusion: then where is my hope?

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Sheol is the world of the dead below the earth, a place of darkness and silence (10:21-22; 14:13).

decisions.choice: hope for: wait for, look forward to
decisions.reason: The verb (qavah) means to wait for or hope for. Job turns it round: the only thing he can look forward to is the grave. The word for "hope" in verse 15 comes from the same root.

decisions.choice: the grave
decisions.reason: Readable says "the grave" for Sheol, as throughout Job.

decisions.choice: "el lugar de los muertos" for Sheol at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As in the Psalms, Spanish names the world of the dead plainly; "la tumba" and "la fosa" are kept for the grave and the pit (verses 1, 14).

decisions.choice: "le séjour des morts" for Sheol at Balanced and Readable
alternatives: "la tombe" at Readable, as the English Readable says "the grave"
decisions.reason: Sheol is the world of the dead (meaning decision m2), and "le séjour des morts" says that in plain French at both levels, as in the Psalms; "la tombe" stays for the pit in verse 14.

decisions.choice: Sheol as "ሲኦል" (L), "የሙታን ዓለም" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms list sets it: Literal keeps the name; Balanced and Readable say "the world of the dead", since "ሲኦል" is heard in Amharic as hell, a place of punishment, which Sheol is not. "መቃብር" (grave) is kept for the Hebrew words for the grave and the pit.

decisions.choice: "… እንበል" (suppose) at the end of verses 13 and 14
decisions.reason: The English Readable opens these lines with "Suppose"; Amharic puts "እንበል" at the end of each clause, so verses 13-14 stay two full sentences before the question of verse 15.

decisions.choice: "शिओल" (L), "अधोलोक" (B), "मृत्यु का लोक" (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol has the three forms the poetry note gives, as in 2 Samuel 22 and the Psalms. Readable says "the world of the dead" where the English says "the grave", keeping "क़ब्र" for the pit (verse 14).

decisions.choice: "шеол" (L), "мир мёртвых" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the poetry note settles for Sheol, the place of the dead (m2). Readable keeps "мир мёртвых" where the English Readable says "the grave", since the Russian is already plain.

source.text: לַשַּׁ֣חַת קָ֭רָאתִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אִמִּ֥י וַ֝אֲחֹתִ֗י לָֽרִמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: To the pit I have called, my father [are] you, my mother and my sister, to the worm,

en.L: [if] to the pit I have called, "You [are] my father," \q "My mother and my sister," to the worm,
en.B: if I say to the pit, "You are my father," \q and to the worm, "My mother and my sister,"
en.R: Suppose I call the grave my father, \q and call the worm my mother and my sister.

es.L: [si] a la fosa he llamado: «Tú [eres] mi padre», \q «Madre mía y hermana mía», al gusano,
es.B: si le digo a la fosa: «Tú eres mi padre», \q y al gusano: «Madre mía, hermana mía»,
es.R: Supongamos que llamo padre a la tumba, \q y que llamo madre y hermana al gusano.

fr.L: [si] à la fosse j’ai crié : « Tu [es] mon père », \q « Ma mère et ma sœur », au ver,
fr.B: si je dis à la fosse : « Tu es mon père », \q et au ver : « Ma mère et ma sœur »,
fr.R: Supposons que j’appelle la tombe mon père, \q et le ver ma mère et ma sœur.

sw.L: [nikiwa] nimeliita shimo, "Wewe [u] baba yangu," \q "Mama yangu na dada yangu," kwa funza,
sw.B: nikiliambia shimo, "Wewe ni baba yangu," \q na funza, "Mama yangu na dada yangu,"
sw.R: Tuseme ninaliita kaburi baba yangu, \q na kumwita funza mama yangu na dada yangu.

vi.L: [nếu] tôi đã gọi huyệt mộ: "Ngươi [là] cha tôi," \q [gọi] con giòi: "Mẹ tôi và chị em tôi,"
vi.B: nếu tôi nói với huyệt mộ: "Ngươi là cha tôi," \q và với con giòi: "Mẹ tôi, chị em tôi,"
vi.R: Giả sử tôi gọi nấm mồ là cha, \q và gọi con giòi là mẹ và chị em của tôi.

ko.L: [내가] 구덩이에게 "너는 내 아버지"라 부르고, \q 구더기에게 "내 어머니, 내 누이"라 [불렀다면],
ko.B: 내가 구덩이에게 "너는 내 아버지다" 하고, \q 구더기에게 "내 어머니, 내 누이" 한다면,
ko.R: 내가 무덤을 내 아버지라 부르고, \q 구더기를 내 어머니요 누이라 부른다고 하자.

pt.L: [se] à cova eu chamo: "Tu [és] o meu pai", \q "Minha mãe e minha irmã", ao verme,
pt.B: se digo à cova: "Tu és o meu pai", \q e ao verme: "Minha mãe e minha irmã",
pt.R: Digamos que eu chame a sepultura de meu pai \q e o verme de minha mãe e minha irmã.

am.L: ጉድጓዱን፦ «አንተ አባቴ ነህ»፣ \q ትሉንም፦ «እናቴና እኅቴ» ብዬ ብጠራ፣
am.B: ጉድጓዱን፦ «አንተ አባቴ ነህ»፣ \q ትሉንም፦ «እናቴ፣ እኅቴ» ብል፣
am.R: መቃብሩን አባቴ ብዬ እጠራዋለሁ እንበል፤ \q ትሉንም እናቴና እኅቴ ብዬ እጠራዋለሁ እንበል።

hi.L: [यदि] मैंने गड्ढे से पुकारकर कहा है, "तुम मेरे पिता [हो]," \q [और] कीड़े से, "मेरी माता और मेरी बहन,"
hi.B: यदि मैं क़ब्र से कहूँ, "तुम मेरे पिता हो," \q और कीड़े से, "मेरी माँ और मेरी बहन,"
hi.R: मान लो कि मैं क़ब्र को अपना पिता कहूँ, \q और कीड़े को अपनी माँ और अपनी बहन।

ru.L: [если] яме я сказал: «Ты мой отец», \q «Моя мать и моя сестра» — червю,
ru.B: если я говорю могиле: «Ты мой отец», \q а червю: «Моя мать и моя сестра»,
ru.R: Допустим, я назову могилу своим отцом, \q а червя — матерью и сестрой.

ja.L: [もし]墓穴に向かって「あなたはわたしの父だ」と呼び、 \q うじに向かって「わたしの母、わたしの姉妹」と[呼ぶのなら]、
ja.B: もし、墓穴に「あなたはわたしの父だ」と言い、 \q うじに「わたしの母、わたしの姉妹」と言うのなら、
ja.R: 仮に、わたしが墓を父と呼び、 \q うじ虫を母や姉妹と呼ぶとしよう。

decisions.choice: the pit: the grave
decisions.reason: The word (shachat) means a pit, the grave (33:18, 22-30). Some take it as "decay", which would also suit the worm in the next line; either way it is the grave and what happens there.

decisions.choice: calling the pit father and the worm mother and sister: death is now his family
decisions.reason: Job claims kinship with the grave and its worms, as if they were the closest family he has left (compare 19:13-19).

decisions.choice: worm: the maggot of decay
decisions.reason: The word (rimmah) is the maggot that eats a dead body (7:5; 21:26; 24:20; 25:6).

decisions.choice: the grave
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plain word for what the pit means (m1).

decisions.choice: the address to the worm moved to the start of the second line
alternatives: the Hebrew order, with "to the worm" at the end
decisions.reason: Vietnamese introduces a quotation with the person spoken to before it ("gọi con giòi: ..."); put after the quotation, "to the worm" would be left hanging.
The pit (shachat) has the poetry note's forms. The pit, addressed as a father, takes "तुम"; "तू" is kept for speech to God.

decisions.choice: "яма" (L), "могила" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The pit (m1), as the poetry note settles it: Literal keeps the picture, Balanced and Readable say the grave.

records.literal_gloss: And where then [is] my hope? and my hope, who will see it?

en.L: Where then [is] my hope? \q And my hope, who will see it?
en.B: Where then is my hope? \q Who can see any hope for me?
en.R: Then where is my hope? \q Can anyone see any hope for me?

es.L: ¿Dónde, pues, [está] mi esperanza? \q Y mi esperanza, ¿quién la verá?
es.B: ¿Dónde está entonces mi esperanza? \q ¿Quién puede ver alguna esperanza para mí?
es.R: Entonces, ¿dónde está mi esperanza? \q ¿Puede alguien ver alguna esperanza para mí?

fr.L: Où donc [est] mon espérance ? \q Et mon espérance, qui la verra ?
fr.B: Où est donc mon espérance ? \q Qui peut voir pour moi le moindre espoir ?
fr.R: Alors, où est mon espoir ? \q Est-ce que quelqu’un voit encore un espoir pour moi ?

sw.L: Basi, tumaini langu [li] wapi? \q Na tumaini langu, ni nani atakayeliona?
sw.B: Basi tumaini langu liko wapi? \q Ni nani awezaye kuona tumaini lolote kwa ajili yangu?
sw.R: Basi tumaini langu liko wapi? \q Je, kuna mtu yeyote anayeona tumaini lolote kwangu?

vi.L: Vậy thì hy vọng của tôi [ở] đâu? \q Và hy vọng của tôi, ai sẽ thấy nó?
vi.B: Vậy thì hy vọng của tôi ở đâu? \q Ai có thể thấy chút hy vọng nào cho tôi?
vi.R: Vậy thì hy vọng của tôi ở đâu? \q Có ai thấy chút hy vọng nào cho tôi không?

ko.L: 그렇다면 내 소망은 어디 [있는가]? \q 내 소망을 누가 보겠는가?
ko.B: 그렇다면 내 소망은 어디 있는가? \q 누가 내게서 소망을 볼 수 있겠는가?
ko.R: 그렇다면 내 소망은 어디 있는가? \q 누가 나에게 무슨 소망이 있다고 보겠는가?

pt.L: Onde, então, [está] a minha esperança? \q E a minha esperança, quem a verá?
pt.B: Onde está, então, a minha esperança? \q Quem consegue ver alguma esperança para mim?
pt.R: Então, onde está a minha esperança? \q Alguém consegue ver alguma esperança para mim?

am.L: እንግዲህ ተስፋዬ ወዴት ነው? \q ተስፋዬንስ ማን ያየዋል?
am.B: እንግዲህ ተስፋዬ የት አለ? \q ለእኔ የሚሆን ተስፋስ ማን ሊያይ ይችላል?
am.R: ታዲያ ተስፋዬ የት አለ? \q ለእኔ ተስፋ የሚያይ ሰው ይኖራል?

hi.L: तो फिर मेरी आशा कहाँ [है]? \q और मेरी आशा, कौन उसे देखेगा?
hi.B: तो फिर मेरी आशा कहाँ है? \q कौन मेरे लिए कोई आशा देख सकता है?
hi.R: तो फिर मेरी आशा कहाँ है? \q क्या किसी को मेरे लिए कोई आशा दिखाई देती है?

ru.L: Где же тогда моя надежда? \q И мою надежду кто увидит?
ru.B: Где же тогда моя надежда? \q Кто разглядит для меня хоть какую-то надежду?
ru.R: Так где же моя надежда? \q Видит ли кто-нибудь для меня хоть какую-то надежду?

ja.L: そのとき、わたしの望みはどこにあるのか？ \q わたしの望み、だれがそれを見るだろうか？
ja.B: それなら、わたしの望みはどこにあるのか？ \q だれが、わたしに望みを見いだせるだろうか？
ja.R: それなら、わたしの望みはどこにあるのだろう？ \q わたしに望みがあると思える人が、だれかいるだろうか？

decisions.choice: then: the conclusion of verses 13-14
decisions.reason: The word "then" draws the conclusion of the "if" in verse 13: if the grave is all he can look for, he has no hope at all.

decisions.choice: my hope (repeated)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats "my hope". The ancient Greek translation has "my good things" in the second line, which may reflect a different Hebrew word. The repeated word of the Hebrew text is kept.

decisions.choice: see it: catch sight of it
decisions.reason: The verb (shur) means to look at or behold. No one, Job says, can see any hope for him.

source.text: בַּדֵּ֣י שְׁאֹ֣ל תֵּרַ֑דְנָה אִם־יַ֖חַד עַל־עָפָ֣ר נָֽחַת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [To the] bars of Sheol will they go down? Or together on [the] dust [is] rest?

en.L: Will they go down [to] the bars of Sheol? \q Or shall we go down together to the dust?
en.B: Will my hope go down to the gates of Sheol? \q Shall we sink into the dust together?
en.R: Will my hope go down with me into the grave? \q Will we lie down in the dust together?

es.L: ¿Descenderán [a] los cerrojos del Seol? \q ¿O descenderemos juntos al polvo?
es.B: ¿Bajará mi esperanza a las puertas del lugar de los muertos? \q ¿Nos hundiremos juntos en el polvo?
es.R: ¿Bajará mi esperanza conmigo al lugar de los muertos? \q ¿Nos acostaremos juntos en el polvo?

fr.L: Descendront-elles [vers] les barres du Shéol ? \q Ou descendrons-nous ensemble à la poussière ?
fr.B: Mon espérance descendra-t-elle aux portes du séjour des morts ? \q Nous enfoncerons-nous ensemble dans la poussière ?
fr.R: Mon espoir va-t-il descendre avec moi au séjour des morts ? \q Allons-nous nous coucher ensemble dans la poussière ?

sw.L: Je, yatashuka [hadi] kwenye makomeo ya Kuzimu? \q Au tutashuka pamoja mavumbini?
sw.B: Je, tumaini langu litashuka hadi malango ya Kuzimu? \q Je, tutazama pamoja mavumbini?
sw.R: Je, tumaini langu litashuka pamoja nami Kuzimu? \q Je, tutalala pamoja mavumbini?

vi.L: Chúng sẽ đi xuống [tới] các then cửa Âm Phủ chăng? \q Hay chúng tôi sẽ cùng nhau đi xuống bụi đất?
vi.B: Hy vọng của tôi sẽ xuống tận cổng Âm Phủ sao? \q Chúng tôi sẽ cùng chìm vào bụi đất sao?
vi.R: Hy vọng của tôi sẽ cùng tôi đi xuống nơi của người chết sao? \q Chúng tôi sẽ cùng nằm trong bụi đất sao?

ko.L: 그것들이 스올의 빗장으로 내려가겠는가? \q 아니면 우리가 함께 흙으로 내려가겠는가?
ko.B: 내 소망이 스올의 문으로 내려가겠는가? \q 우리가 함께 흙 속에 가라앉겠는가?
ko.R: 내 소망이 나와 함께 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳으로 내려가겠는가? \q 우리가 함께 흙 속에 눕겠는가?

pt.L: Descerão elas [às] trancas do Sheol? \q Ou desceremos juntos ao pó?
pt.B: Será que a minha esperança descerá às portas do mundo dos mortos? \q Afundaremos juntos no pó?
pt.R: Será que a minha esperança vai descer comigo ao mundo dos mortos? \q Vamos nos deitar juntos no pó?

am.L: ወደ ሲኦል መቀርቀሪያዎች ይወርዳሉን? \q ወይስ በአንድነት ወደ አፈር እንወርዳለን?
am.B: ተስፋዬ ወደ ሙታን ዓለም ደጆች ይወርዳልን? \q በአንድነትስ ወደ አፈር እንሰምጣለን?
am.R: ተስፋዬ ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ሙታን ዓለም ይወርዳል? \q በአንድነትስ በአፈር ውስጥ እንተኛለን?

hi.L: क्या वे शिओल की अर्गलाओं [तक] उतर जाएँगी? \q या क्या हम साथ-साथ धूल में उतरेंगे?
hi.B: क्या मेरी आशा अधोलोक के फाटकों तक उतर जाएगी? \q क्या हम एक साथ धूल में समा जाएँगे?
hi.R: क्या मेरी आशा भी मेरे साथ मृत्यु के लोक में उतर जाएगी? \q क्या हम दोनों साथ-साथ धूल में लेट जाएँगे?

ru.L: Сойдут ли они [к] засовам шеола? \q Или вместе в прах сойдём?
ru.B: Сойдёт ли моя надежда к воротам мира мёртвых? \q Погрузимся ли мы вместе в прах?
ru.R: Неужели моя надежда сойдёт со мной в мир мёртвых? \q Неужели мы вместе ляжем в прах?

ja.L: それらは陰府のかんぬきへと下るのか？ \q それとも、わたしたちは共に塵へ下るのか？
ja.B: わたしの望みは、陰府の門まで下って行くのか？ \q わたしたちは共に塵の中に沈むのか？
ja.R: わたしの望みは、わたしと一緒に死者の世界へ下って行くのか？ \q わたしたちは一緒に、ちりの中に横たわるのか？

decisions.choice: they: my hopes
decisions.reason: The verb is plural and feminine, as the word "hope" is feminine. Its subject is the hope named twice in verse 15: Job's hope will go down to the grave with him.

decisions.choice: the bars of Sheol: the barred gates of the world of the dead
decisions.reason: The word means bars or poles. Sheol is pictured as a city with barred gates (38:17; Jonah 2:7). The ancient Greek translation has "with me", which would come from very similar Hebrew letters.

decisions.choice: shall we go down: from a verb "go down"
alternatives: is there rest together in the dust?
decisions.reason: The last word (nachat) can be a verb, "we will go down", matching the first line, or a noun, "rest": "or is there rest together in the dust?" Both describe Job and his hope lying in the grave.

decisions.choice: my hope
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the subject (m1). Balanced says "gates" for the bars of the gates (m2); Readable says "the grave" for Sheol and supplies "with me".

decisions.choice: "Descendront-elles" with a feminine plural subject
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is feminine plural, with Job's hopes as its subject (meaning decision m1); French "espérances" is feminine too, so the pronoun can keep the link.
